snippet.title: Toroa: Skycall | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

We’re proud to announce a Spring 2025 release date for Toroa: Skycall, a relaxing flight adventure set across the vast Pacific Ocean. This new trailer is packed with yet-to-be-seen footage of gameplay and cinematics across a variety of locales in the game, showing off the flight mechanics and gorgeous visuals in this epic tale grounded in the Māori world.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003490/Toroa_Skycall/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration  

#frostygamesfest #gaming #indiegames #madeinanz
